submission.justification: Sensor-T3 at 150 um gives the best unirradiated single-hit resolution of all candidates and thicknesses tested (6.057 um; T3 is best at every thickness from 50 to 300 um). The 100 um T3 option carried into the draft (6.317 um) is about 0.26 um worse and has no recorded advantage in the results, so I have changed the recommendation to 150 um. This is a conditional recommendation, not a verified one. The hard constraint is not satisfied by the evidence: no technology has efficiency data versus fluence, none has efficiency verified at 2e16 neq/cm^2, and all three are flagged as unverified. Resolution was only measured unirradiated. Before this design is adopted, hit efficiency of T3 at 150 um must be measured at 2e16 neq/cm^2 and shown to be at or above 97%. If it falls short, the choice must be revisited, including the other technologies and thicknesses, since no fallback has been verified either.

requirements.requirement: Sensor must be one of the three technologies in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Sensor-T3 is one of the three listed candidates (T1, T2, T3).

requirements.requirement: Hit efficiency >= 97% up to end-of-life fluence 2e16 neq/cm^2 (hard requirement)
requirements.evidence: No efficiency-versus-fluence data exists for any technology. num_technologies_verified_ge97pct_at_2e16 = 0 and num_technologies_flagged_eol_efficiency_unverified = 3. The efficiency of T3 at 150 um at 2e16 is unverified, so this hard constraint cannot be confirmed.
Recommended thickness is 150 um, inside the 50-300 um range.

requirements.requirement: Goal: best possible single-hit spatial resolution in the innermost layer
requirements.evidence: Unirradiated resolution for T3 at 150 um is 6.057 um, the lowest of all 18 technology/thickness combinations tested (T1 best 13.591 um, T2 best 9.283 um). This is measured only unirradiated; resolution after irradiation was not measured.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended technology and thickness
requirements.evidence: Submitted Sensor-T3 at 150 um in this single call. The earlier draft choice of 100 um was overridden for the reason given in the justification.
